newsitem.title: USA: JB Oxford cooperating with Fed authorities.
newsitem.headline: JB Oxford cooperating with Fed authorities.

text.p: JB Oxford Holdings Inc said it was cooperating fully with federal authorities in a search of records that was conducted at its Beverly Hills headquarters and its offices in Basel, Switzerland.
The company said it is not in a position to comment on the status or scope of these matters and will continue to conduct its normal business activities.
The Federal Bureau of Investigations earlier said only that several agents executed Federal search warrants related to a white-collar crime investigation.
Shares of JP Oxford were halted on Nasdaq.
Earlier this month, the company reported earnings of $0.01 per share or $105,000 on revenues of $18.2 million for the second quarter ended June 30, 1997.
